summary: Kit 6b: engraved magic circle as a transparent kit piece
author: pm
body:
The magic dialog keeps its engraved hexagram-in-a-ring as a transparent kit piece, an exception to the HH-0066 ruling "Drop the pictures". User asked for a recreation (2026-11-24: "recreate the pentagram for the magic circle as a transparent bevel"), asked for 50% opacity, and approved v6 ("Approve, add to kit").

- Prototype: .claude/scratch/coordinator/magic_circle/make_circle6.py (gitignored scratch), output 200x200 RGBA.
- Geometry (measured on game_dialogs sprite 0 frame 1): centre (128.5, 162.5) in the 258x328 dialog, ring outer radius 90, ring band 7.5, star circumradius 85, star band 9.
- Look: engraved, lit from the top-left, mauve floor, 50% overall opacity.

**Done when:** the panel kit builder generates the piece (--check passes), the staged kit carries it, and the magic dialog draws it at the measured place, verified by a bridge screenshot.

Source: chat, 2026-11-24.
